##


Black Clover Main Characters


#


Most of the cast serves in the Black Bulls or Golden Dawn squads. Here are the main characters with their magic, a canon detail and a Redbean recreation. For a power ranking, see our[strongest Black Clover characters, ranked](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/black-clover-characters-season-2) , which comes with a spoiler warning.


###


Asta


#


[Asta](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/asta-px6h0bzmrbyn) is an orphan raised at a church in Hage who joins the Black Bulls. He has no mana, but his five-leaf clover grimoire holds anti-magic that cuts through and nullifies spells. His goal is to become the Wizard King.


###


Noelle Silva


#


Noelle Silva is the second daughter of the royal House Silva and a Black Bulls member. She uses water magic and spirit magic through a three-leaf clover grimoire. She starts out proud and dismissive and grows kinder as the story goes on.


###


Yuno


#


[Yuno](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/yuno-m6xkfak8ghoz) grew up with Asta at the same church and is his lifelong rival, now a Golden Dawn Magic Knight. He uses wind magic through a four-leaf clover grimoire, which is rare in canon, and he is bonded to the wind spirit Sylph. He speaks little and keeps his feelings to himself.


###


Yami Sukehiro


#


Yami Sukehiro is the captain of the Black Bulls and comes from the Hino Country. He uses rare dark magic channeled through a katana, a sword style from his homeland. Before leading the Black Bulls, he served in the Grey Deer squad.


###


Magna Swing


#


[Magna Swing](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/magna-swing-komol0a087r8) is a commoner from the village of Rayaka and a 5th Class Junior Magic Knight, the lowest rank, in the Black Bulls. He is a short-tempered, blunt fire mage who rides a broom named Crazy Cyclone and is fiercely loyal to Yami.


###


William Vangeance


#


[William Vangeance](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/william-vangeance-sfrx4odthedw) is the former captain of the Golden Dawn, said to be among those closest to becoming the next Wizard King. He uses World Tree Magic through a three-leaf clover grimoire and wears a gold-and-blue mask given to him by Julius Novachrono.


###


Zora Ideale


#


[Zora Ideale](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/zora-ideale-ght7wiphsm74) is a Black Bulls Magic Knight and the son of Zara Ideale, the first peasant Magic Knight. He uses Trap Magic, writing rune arrays and counter traps that reflect spells back with doubled power, and he also uses Ash Magic. He is sharp-tongued and has little patience for nobles.


##


Black Clover OC Maker: Step-by-Step Guide in Redbean


#


###


Step 1: Design Your OC with a Black Clover OC Template


#


To build a Black Clover magic knight OC, decide their background and magic attribute first. Those two choices shape the grimoire, the squad, and how other Magic Knights treat your OC.


####


1. Pick a background


A background gives your OC an attitude before the first spell. Canon characters start from very different places:


- Noble or royal: born into a house with a name to live up to, like Noelle Silva of House Silva or Charlotte Roselei of House Roselei.
- Commoner: from a village, with something to prove, like Magna Swing from Rayaka.
- Orphan or outsider: raised away from the nobility, like Asta at a church in Hage.


####


2. Choose a magic attribute


Pick one clear idea that fits your Black Clover magic knight OC’s personality, then give it a limit.


- Elemental: fire, water, wind, earth or lightning.
- Object or concept: ash, glass, thread, sound or light. Charlotte’s briar magic shows how specific an attribute can get.
- Spells: write three to five with different jobs, such as one that creates, one that boosts speed and one that heals or traps, and give each a cost.


####


3. Design the grimoire


In canon, mages claim their grimoire at 15 during the March Grimoire Acceptance Ceremony, or later at any grimoire tower. A Black Clover grimoire OC needs two decisions about the book:


- Leaves: three-leaf clovers are common. A four-leaf grimoire is rare and goes to an exceptional mage, so use it sparingly.
- Cover: a grimoire’s[cover design](https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Grimoire) reflects its owner’s character, magic attribute, or both, and carries their kingdom’s insignia.


####


4. Pick a squad and a rank


The nine Magic Knight squads are the Black Bulls, Golden Dawn, Silver Eagles, Crimson Lion Kings, Blue Rose Knights, Coral Peacocks, Aqua Deer, Green Mantis and Purple Orcas. Each one has its own insignia and[signature robes](https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Magic_Knights) .


- Squad fit: choose the squad whose cast matches your OC, such as Golden Dawn or the Black Bulls.
- Rank: Junior, Intermediate and Senior Magic Knights are each split into five classes, with 5th class the lowest. Starting your OC at 5th Class Junior leaves room to grow, as with Magna.


####


5. Add personality, a flaw and a goal


Give your Black Clover magic knight OC a clear flaw, such as recklessness or poor mana control, and a goal, such as protecting a hometown or proving a commoner can rise. Both give you something to roleplay.


####


Black Clover OC ideas for your OC, filled-in template


Here is the Black Clover OC template completed for a single Black Clover grimoire OC:


> - Name and origin: *Ilsa Marrow, a commoner from Ashfen, a made-up mining village in the Clover Kingdom.*
> - Magic attribute: *Lantern Magic, which creates light that follows and reveals.*
> - Grimoire: *three-leaf clover, soot-gray cover with a brass clasp and a lantern emblem beside the Clover Kingdom insignia.*
> - Squad: *Black Bulls, 5th Class Junior Magic Knight.*
> - Spells and limit: *Guide Light marks a teammate’s position through smoke and walls, and Dawn Lantern floods a wide area with light but drains most of Ilsa’s mana. Both spells only work on people she has already met.*


###


Step 2: Turn Your OC into a Playable Character


#


- Upload a sketch, fan art or a reference image of your Black Clover magic knight OC. Redbean turns it into a playable pixel character that can move and talk.
- Write a persona, lore and a speaking style for your Black Clover grimoire OC, such as Ilsa narrating her spells like a night watchman.
- Restyle your Black Clover OC maker character anytime with a new picture or a short prompt.
- Give your OC a name and a role in your town, then play as them or keep them as an NPC. You can add a pet made the same way.


###


Step 3: Recreate the Canon Crew and Build Your Clover Kingdom Town


#


- Recreate Asta, Noelle, Yami and the rest from images, as characters or NPCs that share a town with your Black Clover magic knight OC.
- Restyle your town in any theme with a few words, such as a Black Bulls hideout, then make furniture and buildings from a photo, a sketch or a short description.
- Share your town, or visit towns other players built, and mix fandoms to build a crossover town.


###


Step 4: Create Scenarios and Roleplay with Your OC


#


In Redbean’s Black Clover OC maker you write your own lines and can play as anyone in the cast, including your Black Clover magic knight OC. You can:


- Define each character’s personality, role and backstory. They react as who you write them to be.
- Set free-form relationships, such as Magna as a rival or Yami as a mentor. They shift with what you say, and characters remember what you tell them within the story.
- Describe a scene and Redbean turns it into quests with NPCs: get items, escort a character, or fix a house.
- Place Asta next to Noelle and they meet and talk on their own. Characters wander town, keep their own routines and carry on when you are away.


*Black Clover OC ideas for a first scene: the day after the Grimoire Acceptance Ceremony, a new recruit arrives at the Black Bulls hideout. Noelle wants the front hall repaired before Yami wakes up, and Magna is sure the recruit took his broom.*

Free Black Clover OC Maker Tools and Generators Compared


#


Free Black Clover OC makers and character creators fall into three groups: image makers that draw your OC, generators that suggest names and ideas, and Redbean, a Black Clover OC maker that turns an image into a playable character. This table compares five tools as each describes itself (checked November 2026).

For an OC that can talk back and live in a town with canon characters, Redbean is the free option on this list that makes the character playable, though its characters are pixel art and not detailed anime illustrations.


##


Black Clover OC Maker FAQ


#


###


How do I make a Black Clover magic knight OC?


#


To make a Black Clover magic knight OC, choose a background, a magic attribute with a limit, a grimoire design and one of the nine Magic Knight squads. Then draw a sketch or pick a reference image and upload it to Redbean, which turns the OC into a playable pixel character you can talk to and place in a town.


###


Which Black Clover ships and canon pairings are most popular?


#


Asta and Noelle is one of the most popular Black Clover ships, according to[Ranker’s fan-voted ranking](https://www.ranker.com/list/most-popular-ships-in-black-clover/sarahchen) . Side-character pairings also have fans, including Yami and Charlotte, Magna and Luck, and Mereoleona and Rhya. In Redbean you can stage any of them as a friendship, rivalry or slow-burn story.


###


Can I create and play canon x canon or OC x canon stories in Redbean?


#


Yes. In Redbean you can recreate canon characters from images, add your own OC, set the relationship between them and write a scene to play out. You can play as one character and talk to the rest, or place two characters side by side and watch them meet.


###


Do I need to draw well to make a Black Clover OC in Redbean?


#


No. The Black Clover OC maker in Redbean starts a character from an image, so a reference photo or a screenshot of any character, canon or original, is enough, and a rough sketch works too. You can change how your OC looks later with a new picture or a short prompt describing the edit.


###


Besides Black Clover, what other characters can I create in Redbean?


#


Redbean can make any character from an image, including original OCs and favorites from other anime, games and shows, and different fandoms can share one town. Browse the[Redbean Character Gallery](https://www.redbean.ai/characters) for examples, or try the[OC Maker hub](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-maker) , the[Helluva Boss OC maker guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/helluva-boss-characters-and-oc-maker) and the[Forsaken OC maker guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/forsaken-oc-maker) .
